title: Events bubble up, until you stop them

slides.say: Click a button inside a div that also has onClick. Which handler runs? Both.
The event starts where it happened, then travels up the tree. So you get play first, then toolbar.
Handlers get an event object, usually called e. Call e dot stop propagation, and the parent handlers will not fire.

slides.text: Every event bubbles in React except onScroll.
slides.say: Good to know: every event propagates in React, except on scroll, which only works on the tag you attach it to.
